# Sharing an export outside the workspace

> **Status:** 🟡 draft · **Drafted:** 2026-03-11

## Behaviour

A member may create a share link for a finished export, so that someone without an account can
download it once.

A shared link expires 30 days after it is created, matching the archive's own retention.

A share link may be revoked by the member who created it, and by any workspace admin.

Anyone who opens an expired share link sees a page saying the export is no longer available, with no
detail about what it contained.
